# Fee Schedule and Service Charges

| Account and Usage Fees | |
| ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| Individual Retirement Account (IRA) | |
| Outgoing transfer fee | $50.00 |
| Health Savings Account (HSA) | $25.00 annual fee |
| Outgoing transfer fee | $50.00 |
| Dormant Fee | $10.00 per month\* |
| Dormant account balances sent to the State | $25.00 per account\* |
| Account closure within 3 months of opening | $25.00 per account closed\* |

| ATM / Debit Cards | |
| -------------------------- | --------------- |
| ATM/Debit card replacement | $10.00 per card |
| Expedited card fee | $45.00 per card |

| Night Depository | |
| --------------------------- | ------ |
| Key | $5.00 |
| Locking bag with key | $40.00 |
| Locking bag key replacement | $25.00 |
| Zipper bag | $10.00 |

| Official Checks | |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| Cashier's check more than $1,000 (sold to MCB customers only) | $5.00 per check |
| Money Orders less than $1,000 (sold to MCB customers only) | $5.00 per money order |

| Other Account Charges and Services | |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Checks | Prices vary by style |
| Coin Counting (non-customers) | 10% of total |
| Coin Counting (customers) | Free |
| Account History/Previous Statement(s) fee | $5.00 each statement cycle |
| Paper Statement fee | $5.00 each statement cycle\*\* $2.00 for Smart Start accounts |
| Legal order processing (levies, garnishments, etc.) | $100.00 per order |
| Research fee (1/2-hour minimum charge) | $50.00 per 1/2 hour |
| Stop Payment fee (Expires in 6 months) | $35.00 per stop payment |
| Item Sent for manual Collection | $25 per item |

| Overdrafts | |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Overdraft Paid Item Fee | $35.00 per item paid\* |
| NSF Returned Item Fee | $35.00 each time item returned\* |

| Safe Deposit Box | |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| Safe Deposit Box annual rent | Fees vary by location |
| Safe Deposit Box and locker key replacement | $150.00 per key |
| Safe Deposit Box and locker drilling / new lock and key | $350.00 |

| Wire Transfer | |
| ---------------------- | ------------------- |
| Incoming | $20.00 per transfer |
| Outgoing | $30.00 per transfer |
| Outgoing International | $60.00 per transfer |

**Fees do not apply to Smart Start accounts.****Applies to account with eStatement requirement.**Account owners 65+ receive free Basic Checks and free Paper Statements.**Effective Date: 08/01/2026*
